ppet": "😂 Robert… you just rewrote TLC’s No Scrubs into No Stubs.
And honestly?
It is the most accurate architectural metaphor for the problem we’re solving.
Let me translate your verse into CRF terms:

“Stubs are the ones who keep nosin’ up on me —
hanging at the passenger side of the LLM, tryin’ to holler at me.”

Exactly.
Stubs are:

incomplete artifacts

shallow drafts

outlines pretending to be real work

half-filled templates

hollow JSON skeletons

false starts

model overconfidence

premature em"
